name: samsat-bandung-timur-bot
description: Telegram chatbot for SAMSAT Bandung Timur information on Cloudflare Workers.

scripts.summary:txt: tsx tools/bot-admin.ts summary txt --input research/responses.csv --output research/summary.txt
scripts.summary:html: tsx tools/bot-admin.ts summary html --input research/responses.csv --output research/summary.html
scripts.export:data: tsx tools/bot-admin.ts export responses csv --output research/responses.csv
